_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2 — Accounts Payable (Core). Adds Payee, APTransaction, DunningNotice, PaymentRun schemas with x-openregister-lifecycle and x-openregister-aggregations per REQ-AP-001 .. REQ-AP-013. Mirrors the AR core. Consumes OR dunning-workflow (ADR-022) and OR scheduled-workflow for the issued → overdue transition (ADR-031 path 2). Sub-ledger materialises balanced GLTransaction via the T1 JournalEntry pattern. PaymentRun re-established as the canonical batch-payment schema (consolidate-accounts-payable). Seed data per REQ-AP-011 ships Dutch suppliers + a ZZP freelancer + a government payee + AP invoices spanning lifecycle states + an approved PaymentRun.

Payee.title: Payee
Payee.description: Canonical "anyone we pay" master for accounts payable per REQ-AP-002 + REQ-AP-012 — covers suppliers, vendors, AND freelancers (Dutch ZZP'ers / sole traders / contractors), plus government payees. Holds party contact details, payment terms, a structured bankAccount object (IBAN + BIC/SWIFT + account holder), payeeType, folded financial fields (creditLimit, apBalance), dunning policy reference, and default expense account. Folds in the retired VendorFinancialProfile duplicate. Symmetric to CustomerMaster on the AR side. Per REQ-AP-001 + ADR-024 (registers, not parallel PHP tables) + ADR-022 (consumes OR contact abstraction when available via contactRef).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Vendor master register; every create / update / lifecycle transition is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022.

vendorNumber.description: Stable vendor identifier unique per administration. Operator-supplied; never auto-generated.

payeeType.description: Kind of party we pay per REQ-AP-012. supplier/vendor = trading companies; freelancer = Dutch ZZP'er / sole trader; contractor = subcontracted party; government = public-sector payee; other = anything else. The AP module treats every payeeType as a payable party.

paymentTermDays.description: Default payment term in days (auto-sets APTransaction.dueDate on creation per REQ-AP-003).

defaultExpenseAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber for default expense coding on AP invoices.

bankAccount.description: Payee bank account for outgoing SEPA payments. Folds the retired VendorFinancialProfile iban/bic into a structured object. NOTE: bic IS the ISO 9362 SWIFT code (a "SWIFT code" and a BIC are the same identifier) — no separate swift field is modelled. Non-SEPA / cross-border international payments (non-IBAN account numbers, intermediary/correspondent banks) are OUT OF SCOPE here — a future capability; this object models SEPA IBAN/BIC only.

iban.description: Payee IBAN for outgoing SEPA payments. Read by the payment-run SEPA export as the creditor account.

bic.description: Bank ISO 9362 BIC / SWIFT code (same identifier). Creditor agent for the SEPA export.

accountHolderName.description: Name on the bank account, if it differs from the payee legal name.

creditLimit.description: Maximum outstanding AP balance permitted for this payee. Folded in from the retired VendorFinancialProfile per REQ-AP-012.

apBalance.description: Current open accounts-payable balance for this payee (derived open-AP total; mirrors the vendorOpenApBalance aggregation). Folded in from the retired VendorFinancialProfile per REQ-AP-012.

creditTerms.description: Free-text payment terms or reference to OR terms record.

dunningPolicyRef.description: FK to OR dunning-workflow policy record if the extension is stable per ADR-022; else null. Drives REQ-AP-005 reminder cadence from the overdue state.

email.description: Primary contact email for remittance advice and queries.

contactRef.description: FK to OR contact abstraction if stable per ADR-022; else null. Symmetric to AR REQ-AR-002. Resolution deferred to implementing cycle.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this vendor record.

lifecycleState.description: Vendor master lifecycle state. blocked: new AP invoices cannot transition from received to issued; archived: historical reference only.

active.label: Active
active.description: Vendor is active; AP invoices may be received and posted.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Vendor is blocked; new AP invoices cannot transition received → issued.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Vendor is archived for historical reference; no new invoices may be drafted.

block.label: Block vendor
block.description: Suspend new AP invoicing for this vendor (e.g. credit hold or dispute).

archive.label: Archive vendor
archive.description: Archive vendor after all open AP invoices are settled or written off.

APTransaction.title: AP Transaction
APTransaction.description: Accounts payable sub-ledger invoice recording vendor billing and payment obligation per REQ-AP-003. Posting (issued transition) materialises one balanced GLTransaction per T1 REQ-JE-007 (credit AP payable, debit expense per lines). Lifecycle: draft → received → issued → paid with partially-paid / overdue / disputed / written-off / voided branches per REQ-AP-004. The issued → overdue transition fires via OR ScheduledWorkflow (ADR-031 path 2 — no PHP cron job). Aged-payables aggregations (detail / summary / timeline) declared inline per REQ-AP-006 .. REQ-AP-008. Sub-ledger linkage: every GLLine emitted from issue or write-off carries subLedgerType=ap + subLedgerRef=<APTransaction UUID> (REQ-AP-001 scenario).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Bookkeeping sub-ledger register; every lifecycle transition (receive / issue / match / dispute / overdue / write-off / void) and every header/line edit is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. Audit trail is the canonical evidence chain for the AP write-off scenario per REQ-AP-005.

invoiceNumber.description: Vendor invoice number. Unique per administration + vendorId (REQ-AP-003 scenario 2).

vendorId.description: FK to Payee UUID (or slug). Resolves to the vendor record carrying paymentTermDays and dunningPolicyRef.

invoiceDate.description: Date the vendor issued the invoice.

dueDate.description: Auto-calculated from invoiceDate + Payee.paymentTermDays on receipt; operator overrideable.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. T2: base currency only (EUR); T5 adds multi-currency.

totalAmount.description: Total amount including tax in administration base currency. Integer-cent precision applied per ADR-031 money rules. Credit memos are separate journal types, not negative totals.

taxAmount.description: VAT/BTW amount. T3 adds automated reverse-charge logic; T2 carries the field for reporting.

lines.description: Invoice line breakdown. Each line maps to one GL expense account.

amount.description: Line amount net of VAT in administration base currency.

taxCode.description: Tax code for this line (e.g. BTW21, BTW9, BTW0, VERLEGD).

sourceDocumentUri.description: docudesk FK URI per bookkeeping-document-attachment-integration. Points to the uploaded vendor invoice PDF.

state.description: AP invoice lifecycle state per REQ-AP-004.

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction once the invoice is issued (REQ-AP-001 sub-ledger linkage).

writeOffReason.description: Operator-authored audit-trailed reason for write-off. Required on the writeOff lifecycle transition per REQ-AP-005.
writeOffReason.example: Vendor administratie afgewikkeld; restant oninbaar per leveranciersbericht 2026-06-01.

writeOffGlTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the compensating GLTransaction emitted on write-off (debit AP payable, credit bad-debt recovery/write-off expense). Per REQ-AP-005.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod for GL posting (resolved on issue transition per REQ-AP-004 guard 2).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this AP invoice.

retention.description: AP invoices retained 7 years per AWR art. 52 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Lines and header fields may be edited.

received.label: Received
received.description: Vendor invoice physically received and recorded; awaiting approval/posting. Vendor invoice-number uniqueness already enforced.

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: Header immutable. Balanced GLTransaction materialised; awaiting payment match.

partially-paid.label: Partially paid
partially-paid.description: One or more bank-reconciliation matches applied; cumulative matched amount is less than totalAmount.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Full payment matched via bank-reconciliation engine. Terminal state for the happy path.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.description: today > dueDate and no full payment match yet. OR dunning-workflow drives REQ-AP-005 reminder cadence from this state.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Operator placed payment-match pursuit on hold pending vendor-raised dispute investigation.

written-off.label: Written off
written-off.description: Vendor restant uncollectible / waived; compensating GL posting emitted per REQ-AP-005. Terminal state.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Issued invoice voided. The materialised issue GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

receive.label: Receive invoice
receive.description: Operator records vendor invoice receipt. Guard: vendor invoice number unique per (administrationId, vendorId) per REQ-AP-003 scenario 2.
receive.x-adr-031-exception: Single-method guard pending OR's unique-key extension stabilisation. Documented per ADR-031 §'PHP guards remain a legitimate seam' and the spec's REQ-AP-005 fallback clause.

issue.label: Issue / post invoice
issue.description: Operator approves and posts the AP invoice. Guards: (1) balanced materialisation per T1 REQ-JE-007; (2) FiscalPeriod open per REQ-PC-004; (3) Payee.lifecycleState=active. Actions: (a) materialise one balanced GLTransaction (debit expense per line, credit AP payable account); (b) set glTransactionId back-reference; (c) set periodId from invoiceDate.

matchFull.label: Match full payment
matchFull.description: Operator confirms a bank-reconciliation ReconciliationMatch per REQ-AP-009. Guard: cumulative matched amount = totalAmount.

matchPartial.label: Match partial payment
matchPartial.description: Operator confirms a bank-reconciliation ReconciliationMatch per REQ-AP-009 where matched amount < totalAmount.

markOverdue.label: Mark overdue
markOverdue.description: Scheduled lifecycle action fires when today > dueDate and no full payment match yet. Triggered by OR ScheduledWorkflow per REQ-AP-004 + ADR-031 path 2 — NOT a shillinq *Job PHP class.

x-scheduled-workflow.description: Daily 01:00 sweep evaluates open AP invoices and transitions issued|partially-paid → overdue when today > dueDate. Per ADR-031 §'Background jobs that walk an object queue' path 2.

dispute.label: Dispute invoice
dispute.description: Operator marks invoice as disputed. Payment-match pursuit pauses pending resolution.

resolveDispute.label: Resolve dispute
resolveDispute.description: Vendor-raised dispute resolved; payment-match pursuit resumes.

writeOff.label: Write off
writeOff.description: Operator in role controller writes off the residual balance. Action: materialise a compensating balanced GLTransaction (debit AP payable account, credit bad-debt recovery / write-off account). Audit-trailed reason required per REQ-AP-005. Sets writeOffGlTransactionId back-reference.

void.label: Void invoice
void.description: Operator voids the issued invoice. Guard: materialised GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

dunning.description: Per REQ-AP-005 the dunning cadence (reminder-1 / reminder-2 / formal-notice / collection) is owned by OR's dunning-workflow extension. The policy referenced via Payee.dunningPolicyRef drives DunningNotice creation from the overdue state. If OR's extension is not yet stable at implementation time, ADR-031's exception path applies: OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\APGuard ships a single-method fallback documented in the spec.

agedPayablesDetail.description: REQ-AP-006: Aged Payables Detail report — per-invoice breakdown grouped by vendor and due-date bucket. Excludes paid / written-off / voided.

agedPayablesSummary.description: REQ-AP-007: Aged Payables Summary report — vendor totals grouped by aging bucket. Excludes paid / written-off / voided.

agedPayablesTimeline.description: REQ-AP-008: Aged Payables Timeline report — payment due dates with amounts and vendor summary. Excludes paid / written-off / voided.

vendorOpenApBalance.description: Per-vendor open AP balance used by Vendor detail view and pre-payment-run checks. Aggregates open (state in issued/partially-paid/overdue/disputed) APTransaction totals by vendorId.

message.nl: Deze inkoopfactuur staat in Shillinq. Openen?
message.en: This supplier invoice is in Shillinq. Open it?

message.nl: Deze factuur is vervallen in Shillinq. Openen?
message.en: This invoice is overdue in Shillinq. Open it?

DunningNotice.title: Dunning Notice
DunningNotice.description: Per-AP-invoice dunning timeline record per REQ-AP-005. One row per reminder dispatched against one APTransaction in the overdue state. Reminder cadence (reminder-1 at +14d, reminder-2 at +30d, formal-notice at +45d, collection at +60d — all customisable per administration via OR dunning-workflow policy) is owned by OR's dunning-workflow extension, NOT by an app-local PHP service (ADR-022 anti-pattern). This register is a thin audit-trail of what OR's engine emitted.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Dunning-notice timeline; every dispatch and acknowledgement is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022.

reminderLevel.description: Dunning escalation level per REQ-AP-005. Customisable cadence via OR dunning-workflow policy referenced from Payee.dunningPolicyRef.

dispatchedBy.description: Actor that dispatched the reminder. 'system' if emitted by OR's scheduled-workflow; otherwise the operator user-id.

templateRef.description: FK to OR notification template used for the dispatch.

acknowledgedAt.description: When the vendor acknowledged the notice (e.g. promise-to-pay or dispute response).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this dunning notice.

PaymentRun.title: Payment Run
PaymentRun.description: A batch of approved Payee payments per REQ-AP-013 (consolidate-accounts-payable). Groups open AP invoices into a single outgoing payment instruction with a declarative lifecycle draft → approved → exported → reconciled. Approval (RBAC controller) is a hard gate before export — there is NO direct draft → exported transition. The actual SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank-file GENERATION is the separate payment-run-sepa-export change (writes exportedFileRef); this schema models only the batch + its lifecycle. Each paymentLines[] entry references one Payee + one APTransaction. bankAccount.iban / bankAccount.bic on the referenced Payee are the SEPA creditor source of truth.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Payment-batch register; every create / approve / export / reconcile transition is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. Approval and export are the auditable control points before money leaves the administration.

runNumber.description: Stable batch identifier unique per administration. Operator-supplied.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this payment run.

executionDate.description: Requested execution date (ISO 20022 RequestedExecutionDate) for the batch.

debtorAccountIban.description: IBAN of the administration's own (debtor) bank account the batch is paid from. SAFE placeholder in seed data.

status.description: Mirror of lifecycleState for list/filter convenience; the canonical state machine is x-openregister-lifecycle on lifecycleState.

totalAmount.description: Sum of all paymentLines[].amount in the run currency. Integer-cent precision per ADR-031 money rules.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. T2: base currency only (EUR).

paymentLines.description: One line per Payee payment in the batch. Each line references a Payee and the AP invoice being settled.

payeeId.description: FK to Payee UUID / slug being paid.

payeeName.description: Denormalised payee name for display / remittance.

creditorIban.description: Creditor (payee) IBAN, sourced from the referenced Payee.bankAccount.iban. SAFE placeholder in seed data.

amount.description: Line payment amount in the run currency.

remittanceInfo.description: Unstructured or structured remittance reference (ISO 20022 RmtInf) — typically the vendor invoice number.

apTransactionRef.description: FK to the APTransaction UUID / slug this line settles.

exportedFileRef.description: FK / URI to the generated SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file. Written by the separate payment-run-sepa-export change on the export transition; null until exported.

exportedAt.description: Timestamp the batch was exported to a bank file.

reconciledAt.description: Timestamp the batch was reconciled against the bank statement.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Batch under construction; payment lines may be added/removed.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Batch approved by a controller; immutable and ready for export. Hard gate before money leaves the administration.

exported.label: Exported
exported.description: SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file generated (payment-run-sepa-export change); exportedFileRef set.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Batch reconciled against the bank statement; terminal state.

approve.label: Approve payment run
approve.description: Controller approves the batch. Single-approver gate (D4) — there is NO direct draft → exported transition. Approval is the control point before export.

export.label: Export payment run
export.description: Generate the SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file (payment-run-sepa-export change) and set exportedFileRef + exportedAt. Only an approved batch can be exported.

reconcile.label: Reconcile payment run
reconcile.description: Match the exported batch against the bank statement and set reconciledAt. Terminal.
